todos: [P2] FULLTASK-CLOSURE-EVIDENCE-01: after MILESTONE-RENAME-REMAP-01 (2026-09-23) scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b remapped m-6/m-7 to src/App.jsx after the directive rename and verified 7/7 milestones in 12/50 steps, but the run still fails its last assertion: the application closes 'unverifiable' because the generated React/Tailwind project only exposes npm run build (structural evidence), and the plan is thin (one src/App.jsx for both pages, no navigation, no services folder). Next, decide whether the scenario should require a behavioral check the plan must create (e.g. a smoke test milestone from planGenerationAppService) or accept 'unverifiable' with every milestone verified, and raise the plan-coverage bar for the task's required pages/navigation.

[P3] EXPLICIT-ANY-BACKLOG-01: after LINT-STRICTNESS-01 (2026-09-23) biome.json reports noExplicitAny as a warning and no catch clause uses any (shared/domain/errors/errorMessage.ts), but npx biome lint still lists 239 explicit any (mostly Main HTTP/IPC payloads such as sidecarHttpClient.ts requestJson<any>, sidecarAppService.ts results, and test doubles). Next, type the sidecar/Ollama response envelopes and IPC payloads module by module, then raise noExplicitAny to error for electron/ and shared/ via a biome.json override.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: after I18N-HARDCODED-STRINGS-01 (2026-09-24) the renderer UI, the renderer services (translate() in src/i18n/I18nContext.tsx) and the Sidecar ingestion progress (step_code/step_params) are localized, but text produced in Main still reaches the UI in Italian only: agent timeline emitLog messages and closure summaries (e.g. agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts 'Chiusura applicativa', 'NON VERIFICABILE'/'BLOCCATO', agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...'; the default titles 'Nuova Sessione' (electron/core/domain/sessions/sessionHistoryDomain.ts, used as a custom-title sentinel) and 'Nuova Conversazione' (src/hooks/useChatEngine.ts) are persisted data; the Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors. Next, give Main user-facing events a message code plus params rendered by the renderer (keeping the Italian text the model sees unchanged), replace the title sentinels with an explicit untitled flag, and leave the chunk prefix until a re-index migration exists.
